description: This file contains Bitbake recipe functions and Python snippets used for customizing build environment configurations in a Yocto-based build system, specifically for the RDK platform. It manages configuration files, layer paths, and kernel image copying based on machine overrides.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_prepend
methods.description: Writes 'meta/conf' to 'conf/templateconf.cfg' if the file exists in the build directory.

methods.name: do_populate_sdk_ext_append
methods.description: Removes 'conf/templateconf.cfg' if present and certain machine overrides are specified, to prevent build conflicts.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_prepend
methods.description: Appends a generic layer path to 'BBLAYERS' variable if specific machine overrides are present.

methods.name: copy_buildsystem_append
methods.description: Modifies 'bblayers.conf' and copies kernel images based on machine overrides, also appends 'post-build' to local.conf.
